latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the "How to Add Music to a YouTube Video" skill.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files (up to 500MB) and add background music using a cloud-powered workflow.
- Automated setup for cloud back-end with free trial token generation.
- Simple commands to upload, add music, check credits and status, and export 1080p MP4 videos.
- Handles typical edit actions (adding, previewing, exporting) via guided chat prompts and file uploads.
- Clear error feedback for expired tokens, file size/type issues, credits, and export restrictions.
- Fast processing (30-60 seconds per video) with support for iterative editing and thumbnail previews.
